# Third-party libraries

These are unmodified copies of open-source libraries, hosted with the site so
networks that block code CDNs don't break the game.

| Library | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Leaflet](https://leafletjs.com) | 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause |
| [supabase-js](https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js) | 2.117.3 | MIT |
| [three.js](https://threejs.org) | 0.185.1 | MIT |
| [Photo Sphere Viewer](https://photo-sphere-viewer.js.org) | 5.15.1 | MIT |
| [MapillaryJS](https://github.com/mapillary/mapillary-js) | 4.1.2 | MIT |
